opportunities.name: City weekend trip planning and email to friend
opportunities.description: For a given city and dates, gather city facts (Wikipedia, timeanddate weather), find a hotel on Booking, activities on Viator, a dinner reservation on the restaurant site, save a summary note and draft an email to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia, timeanddate, booking, viator, co (restaurant site), notes, mail
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and open the article for population
Search the city on timeanddate and open the weather page
On Booking enter destination, select option, set check-in/out dates and travelers, search, open a hotel
On Viator search for activity 1 and open a result, then search for activity 2 and open a result
On the restaurant site enter location+cuisine, pick date, party size, Find a table, open a restaurant
Create a new note summarizing city, dates, population, temperature, hotel, price, activities, dinner
Compose email to friend with subject and body plan summary, then discard
